info.title: FieldLoop internal mock patrol app
info.description: Synthetic read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local reads need no credentials. No real patrol-app connector, no write operation and no Signal publication.

servers.description: Local simulator as the repository README starts it. Deployed environments call the private simulator-{env} Cloud Run service with a Google OIDC ID token.

get.description: Return the deterministic synthetic right-of-way findings for DL-01, oldest first, each with a GPS fix. This bounded internal fixture list is not the paginated public platform list API.

400.description: The path takes no query, so any query parameter is refused: an undeclared or repeated query parameter; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

405.description: Only GET is served, so every other method is refused; code method_not_allowed, and Allow names the methods the path serves. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
